parameters: \PN handed over the\nMeteorite Shard to Professor Cozmo!\wtnp[40]
\bSteven: I was rather surprised to learn\nthat you knew the professor.
\bYou really do seem to make connections\neverywhere you go.
\bCould I ask you to explain once more about the current plan?
\bProf. Cozmo: I imagine that you've heard\nsome of the situation from\nPresident Stone already.
\bOur current plan involves using the\nInfinity Energy within our rocket,\ncombined with the life energy of humans found in Key Stones…
\bWe will start off by artificially replicating\nthe massive energy that is triggered at\nthe time of Mega Evolution!
\bOur current plan involves using the\nInfinity Energy within our rocket,\ncombined with the energy we have discovered in unique stones…
\bCombined, these two create a massive energy beyond anything we have ever seen!
\bWe will fire the energy produced from\nour rocket into space…
\bBy creating a warp hole in the path of the incoming meteoroid, we hope to be able to transport it somewhere far away from here.
\bAs a matter of fact, this technology already exists and has been incorporated in some of our commonly used devices.
\bI think you know what I mean.
\bThose panels that spin you about and then out you come, warped to another spot.\nI imagine you've stepped on a few such?
\bSteven: An audacious plan…\nAnd using such technology you would…
\bMay I ask where exactly the meteoroid will be warped to?
\bProf. Cozmo: Well.\nWe're not entirely sure, but…
\bWe do have a device that links the warp holes. We've named it the Link Cable.
\bBased on our theory, we can at least guarantee that we will be sending it away from our planet.
\bHowever, we've realized that we will need more energy than originally anticipated to control the Link Cable properly…
\bI'm sorry to ask this of you, but with one more meteorite shard…
\rSo this is the heart of the famous\nSpace Center everyone talks about!
\rExcuse me! Young lady!\nYou can't just let yourself in here!
\rZinnia: Oh? Where's the harm in it?\nDon't be such a stick-in-the-mud! <icon=EIGHTH_NOTE>
\rZinnia: Oh me, we do seem to keep running into one another.
\bProf. Cozmo: Wh-Who are you?!\nWhat're you doing here?!
\rI'm Zinnia.\nJust your regular ol' tourist,\nnothing more.
\rDreaming of taking a little trip into\nspace… Heh.
\rSo this is what has come of human technology and of hope and blood and sweat and tears and…
\rWell, the list gets kinda long and boring.\nBut it contains everything, huh?
\rAbout just what kinda energy you're\nusing to fuel this rocket thing…
\rThe abominable technology humanity\nfirst thought up 3,000 years ago…
\rSo you're once again planning to\nclaim that this is best for humanity,\nor best for the whole darn world…
\rIt's a snap of your fingers to repeat the sins of the past.
\rWorse, if what I overheard is true…
\rThis time, you're about to commit an error more abominable than before!
\bSteven: Tell me, would you rather we sit here wringing our hands, waiting for the meteoroid to strike us?
\rYou're a pretty simple guy for a former Pokémon League Champion.
\rThen I guess I'll hang my hopes on what our current Champion will have to say.
\rWhat do you think?\nDo you have some better idea?
\rYou'll have to tell me so we can set these guys straight.
\rGuess I was expecting more than I should have from you.
\rLook, I'm not here to criticize the way you guys are looking at this.
\rBut I want to be sure you've thought this through well and good.
\rYou know, there are necessary sacrifices, and there are unnecessary sacrifices.
\rThis is the best you could do with all your knowledge and technology?
\rInstead of trying to make something outta nothing, you'd rather repeat the mistakes of the past, straight up?
\rNo, you're gonna add new mistakes on top--that really takes the cake.
\rBut you were all in the middle of a conversation or something, right?\nSorry about that.
\rI guess we'll just let ourselves out, then.
\bAnd the way she spoke to us…
\bIt's almost as if she came here for some kind of confirmation…
\bAnd yet… I feel as though I should know her from…somewhere.
\bI believe you were trying to tell us something before that woman interrupted us?
\bIn order to complete the warp hole, we will need another meteorite shard, an extremely pure one…
\bSteven: Then should we head to\nGranite Cave once again?
\bProf. Cozmo: No… THe kind of meteorite shard we need this time can only be found at Meteor Falls.
\bI see…\nPerhaps we will learn something there…
\bI will head to Meteor Falls at once.
\bFollow as soon as you are ready.
\bI feel we might discover even more than a meteorite shard there…
